prompt: Use only High Efficiency detergents. The package will be marked
response_in_original_text: "HE" or "High Efficiency." Low-water washing creates excessive sudsing with a regular non-HE detergent.
source: Top-Loading High Efficiency Washer Use and Care Guide
context: Instructions for selecting the correct detergent type

prompt: When the START/Pause button is pressed, the washer will fill to an initial water level and begin
response_in_original_text: sensing to determine the load size. The washer will then continue filling to the appropriate water level based on load size and proceed to Wash.
context: Explanation of the automatic load sensing feature

prompt: For best results, evenly load items in loose heaps
response_in_original_text: around the washplate. IMPORTANT: You will not see a washer basket full of water as with your past agitator-style washer.
source: What's New Under the Lid? - Automatic Load Size Sensing

prompt: Select the setting most suitable for your load. For heavily soiled and sturdy fabrics, select
response_in_original_text: Heavy Soil Level for more wash time. For lightly soiled and delicate fabrics, select Light Soil Level for less wash time.
source: Control Panel and Features - Soil Level
context: Guidance on selecting appropriate soil level settings

prompt: Do not wash articles that have been previously cleaned in, washed in, soaked in, or spotted with
response_in_original_text: gasoline, dry-cleaning solvents, or other flammable or explosive substances, as they give off vapors that could ignite or explode.
context: Critical safety warning about flammable materials

prompt: This cycle will fill to a water level higher than in normal wash cycles to provide
response_in_original_text: rinsing at a level above the water line for normal wash cycle. During this cycle, there will be some agitation and spinning to increase the removal of soils.
source: Washer Maintenance - Clean Washer Cycle Operation
context: Description of the cleaning cycle operation
